File guidelines

  • Vector files (AI, EPS) preferred for screen print and embroidery.
  • PNG/JPG accepted at 300 DPI or higher at print size.
  • Max file size 25 MB per upload.
  • Include a note if a color needs to match a specific PMS.
  • Your Paradies rep will confirm the proof before production.
